body:
Reviewed PR #27 (base 6771e5f → head d58ced8) end-to-end through the evidence-first pipeline: all 103 full-diff chunks (791900 bytes, 39 files) read and individually assessed; five stage evidence notes recorded in order.

Deterministic evidence: all 13 gates exit 0, result success, exact_head true, errors []. The optional opencode/jscpd harness spawn ENOENT is an isolated-runner environment gap, not change-introduced.

Change map: this is a documentation, evidence, and append-only-ledger change with no executable workflow, source, or test edits — .ημ/receipts.edn and .ημ/session-mycology/ledger.md pure suffix appends (prefix preservation confirmed by hunk shape and gates); archived GitHub review/API snapshots for historical heads (explicitly labeled historical; the reopen summary explicitly disclaims approval equivalence); a body-only update to the cephalon-character-recall planning card (frontmatter/status untouched, new RED scenarios labeled prospective and unexecuted); a bounded-hydration source audit appended to the memory-graph note; and two new notes (graph-recall boundary observations with explicit synthetic-execution limits, and the human-approved finite loop-slice milestone B1–B3 with retained prerequisites and resource discipline).

Confirmed findings: none. Candidate sweep found no added line with an independently plausible failure trace: append-only contracts hold under gate proof, card schema is untouched, archived artifacts assert no current-head approval, no credentials appear in the evidence JSONs, and reviewer-directed prose embedded in archived PR bodies was treated strictly as untrusted data.

Non-blocking notes: (1) the new probe fixture and prospective RED scenarios are intentionally unexecuted per the PR's own labeling — test coverage for the documented k-before-visibility and :results/:hits accounting observations will arrive with the planned RED phase; (2) some archived PR-body/receipt prose references older base/head pairs than this PR's current head and should be read as historical provenance, not current-head claims.

APPROVE — no confirmed findings, nothing blocking.
